title: QCLI-325 round 2: add the fourth reworded prose site to the drift guard, and correct the CHANGELOG entry (four sites, plus the status-flow fields extension)
description:
Two minor findings from QCLI-325's review round 2 (opum-control review seq 8416, head ee874ae3cbeb4ee1e7eaa4485bb4524486e71ff2). MUST LAND BEFORE THE NEXT lore+quest PAIR RELEASE, because the CHANGELOG entry ships with that release and would otherwise record the wrong scope.

(1) THE DRIFT GUARD MISSES THE FOURTH SITE. test/qcli325-paused-status-fixed.test.ts pins three prose sites (the task status-flow help, the task pause help, the task-finalization guide) against the promise phrasing. QCLI-325's round-1 fix reworded a FOURTH site -- the task start help (src/application/command-help.ts) -- but did not add it to the guard's sites list, so its wording can drift back silently. (The OLD task start phrasing, "does not configure that literal itself", also matches none of the guard's three alternations, so it would need a broader regex or a per-site phrase list.)

(2) THE CHANGELOG UNDERCOUNTS. CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased entry says "the three prose sites that read as a promise of a workspace knob now state the real behaviour", but that same commit reworded FOUR; and the entry calls the change "a docs and wire-field change only" without saying that task status-flow's advertised manifest `fields` gained pausedStatusConfigurable. The durable release record is what a consumer reads to answer "did anything I depend on change?", so both need correcting: four sites, and name the fields extension.

Do NOT amend PR #567 for either -- that would change the approved revision. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: test/qcli325-paused-status-fixed.test.ts's drift guard covers all four reworded prose sites, including the task start help, and the guard's phrases go red against each site's pre-QCLI-325 wording
CHANGELOG.md's entry names four prose sites (not three) and states that task status-flow's manifest `fields` gained `pausedStatusConfigurable`
